svg.title: USGS-02177000: original discharge and microbial sampling
svg.desc: 365 original 2022 daily means and all 16 microbial sample dates at the same station. All sample-date flow qualifiers are A; the seven-day window before 8 March contains four original A;e values. No microbial sample date reaches the annual 95th-percentile daily discharge (1,284 ft3/s). Filled markers are 14 numeric observations; open triangles mark the original limit for two non-detects, with vertical 0–20 censoring bounds. The prior window contains seven complete days and excludes the sample date. Source censoring bounds are distinct from confidence intervals; daily mean flow is context for these concentration observations.
svg.text: USGS-02177000: original discharge and microbial sampling
